subject.title: Add optional `name`/`label` field to group config entries

question: Should OpenClaw add one ignored metadata field to relevant channel group/channel config entries, and what canonical key should be used?
rationale: This changes a public config contract across multiple channels and may affect agent config.patch write policy, so automation should not choose the durable field name or scope on its own.

options.title: Adopt name consistently
options.body: Add name?: string as ignored metadata across relevant group/channel entries, generated metadata, docs, and validation tests.

options.title: Choose label or description
options.body: Use a more explicitly display-only key, accepting the need to document its semantics carefully across channels.

options.title: Decline metadata for now
options.body: Keep strict behavior-only entries and improve ID-discovery or config-tooling guidance instead.

recommendation.title: Adopt name consistently
recommendation.body: Add name?: string as ignored metadata across relevant group/channel entries, generated metadata, docs, and validation tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior review context and broad docs/config-contract history make this the best available owner for the product field-name choice.
